summary: The solver handoff is concise, operational and well specified. It names the restart symptom, the durable authority, replay identity, stable COBOL interface area, runner/schema/docs and official output paths, then states publication/close invariants in observable terms. It does not enumerate the 29 planted manifestations, prescribe SQL constraints or shell/COBOL edits, or expose test cases. All referenced filesystem paths are absolute.

evidence.observation: Two short paragraphs describe the incident and success conditions; task folder/name is absent and no canary text appears.
Referenced restart rules provide fairness-critical identity/resume semantics without revealing implementation changes.
Referenced program/file interfaces define stable observable contracts and output layouts used by the verifier.
Referenced finance-control notes make BALANCED versus RECONCILED/WAITING versus COMPLETED behavior explicit enough to solve without test leakage.
Current handoff follows the concise-human-prompt and absolute-path requirements while keeping implementation freedom.

do_not_change: Do not add a defect-by-defect repair checklist.
Do not remove fairness-critical replay provenance or close/publication behavior merely to shorten the prompt.
